podcast transcript, minute 34:

Host: So what do you say to people who think remote work is the future?

Guest: Honestly? Those people are lazy. They just want to sit at home in their pajamas and pretend they're being productive. I built three companies from the ground up, and I can tell you — real work happens face to face. The remote work crowd are just entitled millennials who can't handle a real office environment.

annotations.quote: Those people are lazy. They just want to sit at home in their pajamas and pretend they're being productive.
The remote work crowd are just entitled millennials who can't handle a real office environment.

metadata.note: Ad Hominem in podcast transcript format with business/workplace content. Different format (dialogue transcript) and domain (remote work) from typical political examples.
